views.title: Academic calendar

views.title: Ask ASCEND

sites.intro: Explore the career-exploration options offered to ISMMS students: electives, NEXUS Learning offerings, host institutions for away rotations, and what returning students said about them.

sites.title: ASCEND Class Calendar
sites.audience: Office of Curricular Affairs staff, via the ASCEND access code on the Hub.
sites.intro: For planning and review by the Office of Curricular Affairs only; not the schedule of record. The class schedule exactly as it stands in the Office of Curricular Affairs' Google Calendar, refreshed automatically every 30 minutes. Two small calendars for the current and next month sit at the top of every view; open on today's sessions with what is next up, see the week as a Monday-to-Friday board, or list every scheduled session grouped by module, by session type (LEC, SGD, CCSG, LAB, PNL, REV, INT and the assessments) or by week.

views.title: Today
views.blurb: The day at a glance: what is happening now or next, every session as a full card with time and type, and a preview of the next three class days. Opens by default.

views.title: Week
views.blurb: Monday to Friday, each session as a card, plus a strip of all-day items and quiz or pre-check windows that span several days.

views.title: All sessions
views.blurb: Every scheduled session from today onward (or the whole calendar), grouped by module, by session type or by week, with each group collapsible. Combine with the module or type filter to see one module's or one type's full schedule.

views.title: Cohort, module and type filters
views.blurb: Switch between class calendars, pick one module, choose session types or assessments from a dropdown, show only mandatory sessions, or search any session by name. The two mini-calendars show where the filtered sessions fall.

views.title: Contact hours
views.blurb: A button on the calendar that totals the scheduled hours for a module, or for every module, in an academic year: instructional and assessment hours, a table by session type, and a CSV download. A planning estimate from the published calendar.

sites.title: Baby Bates
sites.intro: A pocket clinical reference for history-taking and physical examination, drawn from Bates' Guide, to support clinical skills coaching and direct observation.

views.title: Core physical exam
views.blurb: The core exam and exam clusters by system.

views.title: Scripts and algorithms
views.blurb: Illness scripts, clinical scripts, and diagnostic algorithms.

views.title: Quick reference

views.title: Practice of Medicine resources
views.blurb: Materials for coaching and direct observation in the POM modules.
